def _write_script(tmp_path, name, body):
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_text(body)
    return str(path)

def test_r2_waits_for_process_to_complete_by_default(tmp_path):
    marker = tmp_path / "marker.txt"
    script = _write_script(
        tmp_path,
        "slow.py",
        "import time\n"
        "time.sleep(0.5)\n"
        "open({!r}, 'w').write('done')\n".format(str(marker)),
    )
    result = task_func(script)
    assert result == 0
    assert marker.exists()
    assert marker.read_text() == "done"

def _write_script(tmp_path, name, body):

def test_r4_wait_false_does_not_block_on_long_script(tmp_path):
    script = _write_script(
        tmp_path,
        "long.py",
        "import time\ntime.sleep(5)\n",
    )
    start = time.time()
    result = task_func(script, False)
    elapsed = time.time() - start
    assert result is None
    assert elapsed < 3.0

def test_r5_missing_script_raises_value_error(tmp_path):
    missing = str(tmp_path / "does_not_exist.py")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        task_func(missing)

def test_r8_extra_args_are_passed_to_script(tmp_path):
    out = tmp_path / "args.txt"
    script = _write_script(
        tmp_path,
        "args.py",
        "import sys\n"
        "open({!r}, 'w').write('|'.join(sys.argv[1:]))\n".format(str(out)),
    )
    result = task_func(script, True, "alpha", "beta")
    assert result == 0
    assert out.read_text() == "alpha|beta"

def test_r9_default_wait_completes_before_return(tmp_path):
    script = _write_script(
        tmp_path,
        "marker.py",
        "import sys\n"
        "open(sys.argv[1], 'w').write('done')\n"
        "sys.exit(0)\n",
    )
    marker = tmp_path / "marker.txt"
    assert task_func(script, True, str(marker)) == 0
    assert marker.read_text() == "done"
